chapter_title_en: The Path to the Ancient Past
chapter_seo_title: Breaking the Stone Gate: The Time-Reversal World of Shen Du
chapter_meta_description: Five Otherworld Ancestral Gods breach an ancient stone door beneath Shen Du using the legendary Thirty-Three-Layer Pagoda, only to enter a world where time flows backward into the primordial era.
og_title: The Thirty-Three-Layer Pagoda: Portal to a Reversed Time World
og_description: The Otherworld Ancestral Gods break into a sealed underground labyrinth, but find themselves trapped in a backward-flowing time stream leading to the prehistoric age.
twitter_title: Ancestral Gods Enter the Time-Reversal World
twitter_description: The stone door is shattered, but the tunnel leads not to treasure but to a primordial era where time moves in reverse. Xiao Chen follows in secret.
